notes.title: Automaton Ability Glitch Fixed
notes.content: Fixed a bug causing the Automaton magnet ability to stop working.

notes.title: Preparation for Pilots Update
notes.content:
In this patch, I fixed a bug with the music settings menu.

Also, I modularized ship abilities in preparation for implementation of the Pilots system.

notes.title: Glare Glitch in Hangar
notes.content: Fixed a glitch that can cause a strong glare to occur in space station hangars.

notes.title: Fixed projectiles not moving bug
notes.content: Fixed a bug causing projectiles to come out but not move.

notes.title: Extra star glitch
notes.content: Fixed a glitch causing an extra star to appear at the bottom of the screen and remain there throughout the duration of a battle.

notes.title: Fixed ship swapping repairs destroyed ship bug
notes.content: Fixed a bug which caused swapping ships to repair destroyed ships.

notes.title: Fixed copilot able to move while game is paused bug
notes.content: Fixed copilot able to move while game is paused bug

notes.title: Fixed Weapons Test Bug
notes.content:
Fixed a bug causing the weapons test in station hangars to not work.
Fixed a bug causing weapon projectiles to impact asteroid ores.

notes.content: Fixed a bug causing player ship rotation to be disabled

notes.title: Storage Gauge Added to Pause Menu
notes.content: Added a ship storage gauge to the pause menu.

notes.title: Ore Backpack Capacity Color Coding
notes.content: Added capacity color coding to the Ore Backpack Capacity Bar in battle scenes.

notes.title: Market Variation Improved
notes.content: Improved Market Variation. Weapon object clearing from Markets after exiting has been improved. Mystic level weapons no longer spawn in the Mothership Marketplace.

notes.title: Backpack Bar Fix
notes.content: Fixed a glitch causing the ultimate charge bar to appear over top of backpack capacity bar.

notes.title: Correct Mothership Hangar Colors
notes.content: Fixed a bug causing Mothership hangar colors to be incorrect.

notes.title: Player Mothership Added
notes.content:
Added in a visitable player mothership with a market and hangar.
Mine ore from asteroids to repair and refuel in the mothership hangar.
You can still repair and refuel in space stations without ore.

notes.title: Level Progression Bug Fixed
notes.content: Fixed a bug causing the player to be unable to progress to the next level.
